questions.question: January challenge: During new-year competency practice, a Class 11 learner is reviewing Reading Comprehension. a writer uses a contrast between two characters mainly to:
questions.explanation: Contrast can reveal character traits and sharpen a central conflict.
questions.subject: English Core

questions.question: January challenge: During new-year competency practice, a Class 11 learner is reviewing Reading Comprehension. the tone of a passage is best identified through its:
questions.explanation: Tone is conveyed through diction, imagery and the writer’s attitude.
questions.subject: English Core

questions.question: January challenge: During new-year competency practice, a Class 11 learner is reviewing Writing Skills. a formal invitation should primarily use:
questions.explanation: Formal invitations use concise, polite and relevant information.
questions.subject: English Core

questions.question: January challenge: During new-year competency practice, a Class 11 learner is reviewing Writing Skills. in a report, the findings section should present:
questions.explanation: Findings communicate the evidence gathered during the investigation.
questions.subject: English Core

questions.question: January challenge: During new-year competency practice, a Class 11 learner is reviewing Grammar. choose the correct form: “Neither of the answers ___ correct.”
questions.explanation: Neither is treated as singular in standard formal usage.
questions.subject: English Core

questions.question: January challenge: During new-year competency practice, a Class 11 learner is reviewing Grammar. identify the passive form of “The committee approved the plan.”

options.A: The plan was approved by the committee.

questions.explanation: The object becomes the subject and the verb takes the passive form.
questions.subject: English Core

questions.question: January challenge: During new-year competency practice, a Class 11 learner is reviewing Literary Devices. a comparison using “like” or “as” is a:
questions.explanation: A simile makes an explicit comparison using like or as.
questions.subject: English Core

questions.question: January challenge: During new-year competency practice, a Class 11 learner is reviewing Literary Devices. a recurring image or idea in a literary work is a:
questions.explanation: A motif is a recurring element that contributes to meaning.
questions.subject: English Core

questions.question: January challenge: During new-year competency practice, a Class 11 learner is reviewing Poetry. enjambment occurs when:

options.A: A sentence continues beyond a line break

questions.explanation: Enjambment carries syntax or sense across a line ending.
questions.subject: English Core

questions.question: January challenge: During new-year competency practice, a Class 11 learner is reviewing Literature. a narrator who knows the thoughts of several characters is usually:
questions.explanation: An omniscient narrator can access multiple characters’ thoughts.
questions.subject: English Core

questions.question: January challenge: During new-year competency practice, a Class 11 learner is reviewing Reading Comprehension. an inference is a conclusion drawn from:

options.A: Clues and evidence in the text

questions.explanation: Inference combines textual clues with reasoned interpretation.
questions.subject: English Core

questions.question: January challenge: During new-year competency practice, a Class 11 learner is reviewing Writing Skills. a thesis statement should:
questions.explanation: A thesis clearly expresses the main claim the writing will develop.
questions.subject: English Core

questions.question: January challenge: During new-year competency practice, a Class 11 learner is reviewing Grammar. which sentence uses a defining relative clause correctly?

options.A: The student who won the prize thanked her teacher.
options.B: The student, who won the prize thanked her teacher.
options.C: The student who won the prize, thanked her teacher.
options.D: The student won who the prize.

questions.explanation: A defining relative clause identifies which student is meant and is not set off by commas.
questions.subject: English Core

questions.question: January challenge: During new-year competency practice, a Class 11 learner is reviewing Literature. the central message explored by a literary work is its:
questions.explanation: Theme is the underlying idea or message developed through the work.
questions.subject: English Core

questions.question: January challenge: During new-year competency practice, a Class 11 learner is reviewing Writing Skills. a coherent paragraph should have:

options.A: A clear main idea and logically linked support

questions.explanation: Coherence comes from unity, logical sequencing and appropriate links.
questions.subject: English Core
